summary: FRONTEND visual/smoke pass on Customer Stock Dashboard rework. All acceptance criteria verified: 24 tiles render; first 4 tiles are Seed A, Seed C, Seed G, Seed H with data-priority='true', rose border, rose initials avatar and 'Reorder' priority-badge; 4 priority-badge-* and 4 low-stock-badge-* elements present; csd-low-stock-count reads '4 customers need a reorder'; priority tile stock number rendered in rgb(190,18,60)=rose-700; grid is 5 columns at 1920px; all customer names are 14px weight 700; no visible leaf element exceeds 20px font size. Excel export button downloads customer-stock-2026-09-18.xlsx; distributor filter narrows tiles 24 -> 13 as expected. Green tiles (Seed B, D, I, Demo Fresh Mart) show emerald next-order block with dates; Seed E shows 'No branded SKU'; Seed F shows em-dash for next order and last order; Seed H shows '0 cr'; Seed G shows two SKU rows plus Total row (10 cr). Mobile 390px screenshot renders single-column, readable. Only console noise: two 401s on unrelated resource fetches (not blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: CustomerStockDashboard rework verified in iteration 378. Screenshots at /app/test_reports/screenshots/csd_desktop_1920.png and csd_mobile_390.png.
